sentences.en: That makes me feel good, and also lessens my workload.
sentences.zh: 这让我感觉很好，也能减轻我的工作量。

sentences.en: This heavy workload is too much for me.
sentences.zh: 这么大的工作量对我来说太多了。

sentences.en: High blood pressure increases the workload of the heart and the arteries.
sentences.zh: 高血压会增加心脏和血管的工作负担。

senses.zh: （某一人或组织）工作量，工作负担
